race.comment: ATMOSPHERE (3) hasn't won for nearly a year but is going as good as ever and just needs to hold his form to prove hard to beat. Is drawn to advantage and is sure to be in this for a long way. Deserves one. LAST COMMAND (5) looks the main danger with some strong recent finishes to his name. Just missed as favourite at Eagle Farm after savaging the line in a hot form race here two back. Gets a key switch in Thompson and has to be taken very seriously. FABULANTES (2) drops back from stronger company and should be hitting his straps now. Expecting him to like his first look at the mile. BLUEPINOT (7) is a model of consistency for the Waller camp and is sure to put his best foot forward again, while LAST CHANCE SALOON (10) shoulders peaks that measure up and he might be able to make his presence felt at long odds.
